about.title: About KanTrack
about.intro: KanTrack is a privacy-first, local-only Kanban board built for focus and clarity. No accounts. No cloud. No distractions. Just you and your work.
about.features.title: Features
about.features.fourColumn: Four-column board - To Do, In Progress, On Hold, Done
about.features.richDetails: Rich task details with notes, timers, priorities, due dates & tags
about.features.notebook: Built-in Notebook for freeform notes and documentation
about.features.search: Full-text search, column filters, and tag filters
about.features.exports: Export to PDF, HTML, JSON, and encrypted backup
about.features.undoRedo: Undo / redo for all task actions
about.dataLives.title: Where Your Data Lives
about.dataLives.row1.label: Tasks, notes, tags, history
about.dataLives.row2.label: Notebook pages & images
about.dataLives.row3.label: UI preferences
about.dataLives.row4.label: Encryption keys
about.dataLives.row4.value: Never stored -> derived per-session from your password
about.dataLives.note: Nothing is sent to any server. KanTrack has no backend, no accounts, and makes no network requests. All storage is local to your browser.
about.protects.title: What KanTrack Protects Against
about.protects.xss: XSS via imported data - an allowlist-based sanitizer strips all event handlers and unsafe tags before any HTML is rendered to the page
about.protects.inlineScript.part1: Inline script injection - a strict Content Security Policy (
about.protects.maliciousImport.part1: Malicious import files - the sanitizer also runs on content from imported
about.protects.encryption: Encrypted exports use AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2 key derivation (100,000 iterations, SHA-256)
about.limitations.title: Known Limitations - Read These
about.limitations.deviceCompromise: Device compromise - if your device is infected or physically accessed, data in localStorage and IndexedDB is readable. KanTrack cannot protect against OS-level access.
about.limitations.browserExtensions: Browser extensions - extensions with broad permissions can read page content and storage. Use a minimal-extension browser profile for sensitive data.
about.limitations.unencryptedExports.par: exports are plain JSON. Use the encrypted export for sensitive data.
about.limitations.dataAtRest: Data at rest - KanTrack does not encrypt data in localStorage or IndexedDB. Anyone with access to your logged-in account can read it via browser DevTools.
about.limitations.passwordStrength: Password strength - the encrypted export is only as strong as the password you choose.
about.limitations.honestNote: We cannot protect your data if your device is compromised. That is an honest limitation we cannot engineer away.
about.vulnerability.title: Report a Vulnerability
about.vulnerability.part1: Found a security issue? Do not open a public issue.
support.title: Support KanTrack ☕
support.intro: KanTrack is free and always will be! No ads, no accounts required, no tracking. We built it this way on purpose, because we believe your workspace is yours alone.
support.whyMatters.title: Why your support matters
support.whyMatters.body: Keeping KanTrack alive has real costs, the domain, the infrastructure, and the time it takes to build things right. There are no investors or corporate backing behind this. It's just us, building something we believe in. If KanTrack helps you stay organized and clear-headed, a coffee goes a long way.
support.buildingNext.title: What we're building next
support.buildingNext.intro: Your support helps fund the next chapter of KanTrack:
support.buildingNext.vault.title: Encrypted Cloud Vault
support.buildingNext.vault.body: - zero-knowledge backup. The server will never be able to read your data, only you can.
support.buildingNext.sync.title: Multi-device Sync
support.buildingNext.sync.body: - your board, seamlessly current across all your devices, with conflict resolution that stays out of your way.
support.buildingNext.optional: All of this is optional. Local Mode stays free and fully featured, forever. No paywalls on existing features, ever.
support.buildingNext.otherProjects: Your support also helps fund our other open projects. See what we're working on
help.yourBoard.title: Your Board
help.kanbanColumns.title: Kanban columns
help.kanbanColumns.body: Four columns: To Do, In Progress, On Hold, and Done. Move tasks between them by drag and drop.
help.doneLimit.title: Done column limit
help.doneLimit.body: The Done column holds at most 30 cards. Once it's full, a dialog flags the 15 oldest for permanent deletion and lets you export each one - or all of them bundled as a ZIP - to PDF first. This bypasses the Trash entirely and cannot be undone, so the dialog stays open until you confirm.
help.hiddenCards.title: Hidden cards
help.hiddenCards.body: Hide a To Do or On Hold card with the eye-off button to tuck it off the board without deleting it - it leaves the column counts and the Done limit too (not available for In Progress or Done cards). The "Hidden Cards" header button shows a count badge; restore one card at a time or select several with "Select All" + "Show Selected". While searching, a hint links straight to any matching hidden cards.
help.priorityTinting.title: Priority tinting
help.priorityTinting.body: High, Medium, and Low priority with colour tinting. Columns auto-sort so the most important work rises to the top.
help.dueDates.title: Due dates
help.dueDates.body: Due date indicators on cards with clear overdue and due-today states so nothing slips past you.
help.tags.title: Tags
help.tags.body: Colour-coded labels with a preset palette or custom hex. Pin your most-used tags for fast assignment.
help.searchFilter.title: Search and filter
help.searchFilter.body: Full-text search with tag and column filters. Find anything immediately across your entire board.
help.cardSizes.title: Card sizes
help.cardSizes.body: Small, Medium, and Large card display sizes. Your preference persists across sessions.
help.themeFeature.title: Theme
help.themeFeature.body: Light, Dark, or System Default, selectable from the ⋮ menu. System Default follows your OS appearance live; choosing Light or Dark explicitly overrides the OS setting and persists across every future session until you switch back to System Default.
help.languageFeature.title: Language
help.languageFeature.body: Choose System Default, English (UK), Español, Français, Português (PT), or Deutsch (DE) from the ⋮ menu to control spell-check on card and notebook text - independent of your browser's language. System Default leaves spell-check to your browser as usual; an explicit choice applies only within KanTrack and persists across sessions. Note: support varies by browser - Safari and Firefox honour this choice, while Chrome and Edge may continue to spell-check using their own language settings.
help.worldClocks.title: World clocks
help.worldClocks.body: Timezone clocks and a chronometer in a widget row above the board. Reset collapses the row: current time moves to the header and a clock icon button lets you add more. Adding any clock restores the full widget row. On narrow screens (≤ 700 px wide) the widget row hides automatically and only the current time is shown in the header; it reappears when you widen the window.
help.taskDetail.title: Task Detail
help.richNotes.title: Rich notes
help.richNotes.body: Bold, italic, and strikethrough formatting. Paste images directly, stored locally and viewable in a full-screen zoom viewer.
help.editLog.title: Edit log
help.editLog.body: Chronological log of every edit and deletion. Full history of how a task evolved, always visible inside the task.
help.subtasks.title: Sub-tasks
help.subtasks.body: A collapsible mini kanban board inside any task. Same four columns, drag-and-drop between states, with a live done/total counter on the parent card.
help.timer.title: Timer
help.timer.body: Per-task time tracking with quick-add and quick-remove controls directly inside the task detail view.
help.inlineRename.title: Inline rename
help.inlineRename.body: Double-click the task title to rename it inline without opening a separate form.
help.saveOptions.title: Save options
help.saveOptions.part1: keeps the task open for multi-step edits.
help.saveOptions.part2: saves and dismisses in one action.
help.notebook.title: Notebook
help.notebook.body: A resizable sidebar with a folder and page tree for notes and longer-form thinking. Pages support rich text with image paste, per-page PDF export, drag-and-drop reordering, right-click context menus for rename and delete, and live search by name. Export a folder or the full notebook as a ZIP archive and import pages back from ZIP.
help.privacy.title: Privacy
help.privacy.body: KanTrack stores all data in your browser's IndexedDB and localStorage. Nothing is transmitted, synced, or logged to any server. No analytics. No telemetry. No cookies. A Content Security Policy enforced at the browser level blocks all third-party scripts and network connections. KanTrack monitors your browser storage quota and prompts you to export a backup when usage reaches 85%.

privacy.section6.title: 6. Your rights (GDPR)
privacy.section6.p1: If you are located in the European Union or European Economic Area, you have the following rights under the GDPR. As described above, the only personal data we may hold about you is standard HTTP request data processed by our hosting infrastructure. Your rights are listed below in full for transparency:

privacy.section6.right2.title: Right to rectification (Art. 16)
privacy.section6.right2.body: you may ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.section6.right3.title: Right to erasure (Art. 17)
privacy.section6.right3.body: you may ask us to delete any personal data we hold, where no legal obligation requires us to retain it.
privacy.section6.right4.title: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18)
privacy.section6.right4.body: you may ask us to restrict how we use your data in certain circumstances.
privacy.section6.right5.title: Right to data portability (Art. 20)
privacy.section6.right5.body: where processing is based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means, you may request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy.section6.right6.title: Right to object (Art. 21)
privacy.section6.right6.body: you may object to processing based on legitimate interest. We will stop unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds.
